title: CATCHON
tagline: No code solution for NFT based ecommerce protocol. It can help people bridge the physical items with digital asset.
description: This product focuses on connecting the virtual token(NFT) with the actual product one want to sell in reality. We are providing a no-code solution to make this possible, and easy to be used by sellers and cusotmers even with zero knowledge of web3. For a seller, instead of selling face to face, a proof of ownership represented by NFT is sold (or minted for a more web3 term). With the NFT, buyers can trande in a secondary market, which in turn increases the liquidity of the product itself, without the product even leaving the store. Seller does not need to worry about the process of publishing NFTs because we take care of all of it. When a buyer decides to take the actual product, he or she will need to do a on-chain "burn" operation which will let the buyer input the shipping address if that's the method chosen by the seller. Does that mean the buyer will need to know how to do a burn? Not exactly. From a website which we will be helping the seller to build, buyers or NFT owners can easily burn(or we also call redeem) the NFT by just clicking a button. With the shipping address manageable directly from our website, seller can start prepare the shipping orders with the products they want to sell.
how_its_made: For smart contracts part, we use proxy pattern and factory pattern to make the contract deployment smooth and the interaction with contracts easy and simple. A factory pattern also makes it extremely easy to expand the function of our products. For a seller-side managing website, it's a react app which we have crafted to make the smart contracts access super straightforward for anyone with little or even zero web3 knowledge. For the buyer-side, we provide a snnipet of two-line code to be embeded to a pre-designed website template(we suggested webflow) so buyers can easily mint NFTs. The goal of us is to provide a no-code experience.
